ac_analysis.$comment: The ticket carries NO written acceptance criteria — its description is a single design-mockup link. The oracle used instead was the five design screenshots in PR #2417 (all opened and read) plus the diff itself. Conditions below are the atomic testable conditions derived from that oracle, not story ACs.

promotion.$comment: Applied 2026-08-06. Automated = green under the automated regression runner (REG-2026-08-06-0234). Reviewed = verified live but only by the interactive variant-matrix pass on the seeded REV_VAR_FIVE_STAR host, not by the automated runner. Nothing was reverted: no case failed and none carried an ungrounded assertion.

blocked.reason: interactive-star half unreachable — no storefront account on vcst-qa reaches canLeaveFeedback=true, so .vc-rating--interactive never renders there. The 24x24 / focus-ring contract IS proven, but in Storybook (Interactive story, measured 26x26), not on the storefront. Stays Draft until the account gap (finding F7) is resolved.

promotion.incident: The first promotion pass wrote 16 rows with a lone LF instead of CRLF. The file is otherwise pure CRLF, so csv-parse had auto-detected CRLF as the record delimiter and stopped terminating records at REV-SF-012 — one 225-column record swallowing the rest of the file, caught by suites:lint (CSV_RECORD_INCONSISTENT_COLUMNS). Fixed by normalising every lone LF back to CRLF; re-parsed to 29 records x 15 columns before re-running the gates. Quoting was never damaged.

regression.pass_rate_basis: 20 passed / 20 executed. 8 of the 28 cases were BLOCKED on test-data or account gaps and never executed; counting them as denominator gives 71.4%. No case FAILED.
regression.notes: Primary lane playwright-firefox hit a browser-lane defect (requestAnimationFrame never fired, every actionability check timed out); 9 lane-blocked cases were re-run cleanly on playwright-edge. That lane defect is unrelated to VCST-5487 and warrants its own ticket.

bugs_filed.rationale: introduced by this PR — reported in the originating ticket per reporter instruction

findings.$comment: Triaged at 5d but NOT yet filed — filing awaits user confirmation (5f). provenance: in-scope = introduced by this PR; pre-existing = reproduces independently of it.

in_scope.title: Russian review count uses the wrong plural form for 2-4
in_scope.detail: The new key common.labels.reviews_count declares THREE plural forms ('no reviews | {n} review | {n} reviews'). Russian needs FOUR (0 / 1 / 2-4 / 5+), so the few-form collapses onto the many-form. Observed live: 2 reviews renders '2 отзывов' instead of '2 отзыва'. n=1 and n=5+ are correct. n=3 / n=4 not observed separately but share the CLDR 'few' category and therefore the same defect. Affects every 4-form Slavic locale shipped (ru, pl).

in_scope.title: Focus indicator on rating stars fails WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast
in_scope.detail: The new :focus-visible rule uses outline-color --color-primary-300 (#fdc77c), measured 1.54:1 against a white background; 3:1 is required. Net improvement over master, which had no :focus-visible rule at all (SC 2.4.7 was failing outright), so this is a partial fix rather than a regression. Needs a darker token.

in_scope.title: Dead duplicate outline-color declaration in the compiled focus rule
in_scope.detail: Compiled CSS emits outline-color twice on .vc-rating__button:focus-visible (--color-primary-100 then --color-primary-300); only the second applies. Suggests a stray outline-primary-100 class alongside outline-primary-300 in the source. Harmless, worth cleaning.

pre_existing.title: Review photo thumbnails 404 on the _sm suffix, then re-download the full-size original
pre_existing.detail: VcImage's size-suffix convention works for CMS catalog assets but never for platform blob URLs (/api/files/<guid>), which is exactly how review images are stored. Each distinct file 404s then falls back to the original — one fixture serves a 5177x2912 JPEG into a 70x70 box. Scales with DISTINCT files on the page, not per-review image count (10 thumbnails over 4 unique files = 4 404s), and is NOT cached, so a browsing session accumulates dozens. The removed pre-PR markup used the same size-suffix='sm', so this predates the redesign.

pre_existing.title: Image-modal pagination dots are 13x13 spans with no role, tabindex or accessible name
pre_existing.detail: Swiper's default bullets, supplied by the shared VcCarousel, not authored by this PR — the new modal is merely the first surface to expose them. Functional (clicking dot 5 jumps to 5/5) but below WCAG 2.5.8 (24x24) and lacking a name/role (4.1.2). Not a 2.1.1 failure: slide navigation stays fully keyboard-operable via the focusable Previous/Next buttons and the ArrowLeft/ArrowRight handlers.

pre_existing.title: Review-card star row wraps to two lines at 375px when the author name is long
pre_existing.detail: At 375px a 30-char author name takes 190px of the 281px head, squeezing the rating below the 90px it needs: stars 1-4 at y=314, star 5 at y=332 (box 82x36 instead of 90x18). Only 8px short, so it fires on any real long display name. Provenance resolved from the diff: the pre-PR container was 'flex items-start justify-between gap-2' — equally without flex-shrink:0 — and carried size='sm' (16px) stars versus the new size='xs' (14px), i.e. the old markup needed MORE width and was more prone to this. Pre-existing; the PR narrowed the trigger. Minimal fix belongs in the reviews SCSS (flex-shrink:0 on the rating slot), NOT in the shared .vc-rating.

pre_existing.title: No storefront account on vcst-qa reaches canLeaveFeedback=true, even with a genuine Completed order
pre_existing.detail: Blocks 5 pre-existing cases (REV-SF-004/005/006/008/011) plus the interactive half of REV-SF-028 — i.e. the entire review-submission surface is untestable on this environment. The regression run added new evidence: a real Completed order did NOT surface the Leave-feedback button, so this may be a product defect rather than merely a seeding gap. Out of scope for VCST-5487 (that surface is unchanged by the PR) but it is the single largest coverage hole in this domain and needs its own investigation.

pre_existing.title: playwright-firefox MCP lane defect — requestAnimationFrame never fires
pre_existing.detail: Every click/hover/type actionability check timed out on the firefox lane during REG-2026-08-06-0234, affecting 15 cases; 9 were re-run cleanly on playwright-edge. Entirely unrelated to VCST-5487 — a test-infrastructure issue that will corrupt any future firefox-lane run until fixed.

test_data_seeded.$comment: A render-variant matrix was seeded specifically for this ticket because the environment's organic review data covered only image counts {0,1,2,5} and left the empty-body, long-text, 3-image, 4-image, aggregate-1.0 and single-image-modal branches with no fixture at all.
test_data_seeded.seeder: npm run seed:review-variants (teardown: npm run seed:review-variants:teardown)

hosts.REV_VAR_MATRIX: Canon Imageclass MF232W — 8 approved reviews, aggregate 3.375 renders '3.4', 8 > PAGE_SIZE so the list paginates; covers text-only / long-text(2069ch) / empty-body / 1,2,3,4 images
hosts.REV_VAR_FIVE_STAR: Epson XP-830 — single 5-star review with exactly ONE image, aggregate 5.0 + the images.length===1 modal branch

appinsights.skipped_reason: APPINSIGHTS_API_KEY is not set and the Azure MCP server was not available in this session. APPINSIGHTS_APP_ID_* are configured but unusable without the key. Skipped per the command's graceful-degradation rule; does not gate the verdict.

verdict_rationale: Downgraded from PASS_WITH_NOTES on the reporter's instruction: three defects (F1 RU plural, F2 focus-ring contrast, F3 dead CSS declaration) were INTRODUCED by this PR, so rather than filing separate tickets they are reported on VCST-5487 itself and the ticket is reopened for the author to fix in place. All three are minor (P3) and none blocks the redesign, which matches the mockup; the verdict reflects ownership of the fix, not severity.
